simple.meaning: בֶּצֶל (betsel) is a Hebrew word meaning “an onion.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.

definitions.full: H1211. batsal [ בָּצָל ] noun masculine onion (Late Hebrew בָּצֵל or בֶּ֫צֶל , Arabic , Ethiopic Aramaic בּוּצְלָא , ) — בְּצָלִים Num 11:5 ( ׳וְאֶתהַֿבּ וְאֵתהַֿשּׁוּמִים וְאֶתהֶֿחָצִיר הָאֲבַטִּתִים וְאֵת הַקִּשֻּׁאִים אֵת ).
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root apparently meaning to peel;

occurrences.englishText: We remember the fish, which we ate in Egypt for nothing; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic;
